rubrics.justification: Accurately describes an expanded blastocyst with thinned zona, fair/loosely grouped ICM, and fair/sparse TE consistent with BB morphology; notes the likely stage discrepancy between 3BB and expanded morphology. Minor limitation from relying partly on provided grade rather than image alone.
Strongly integrates age, ovarian reserve markers, oocyte yield, semen parameters, endometrial thickness, first-cycle status, and lifestyle factors with embryo quality to contextualize prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with prognosis appropriately balancing mid-grade morphology against favorable age and cycle factors. Minor issue is somewhat optimistic implantation/live birth estimates for an untested BB embryo.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice guidelines: transfer is appropriate, SET is preferred at age 29, routine luteal support is reasonable, and PGT-A is not routinely required in a first cycle at this age. Small deviation is the relatively optimistic success range and some overinterpretation of DOR labeling.

Provides clear next steps for current transfer and future planning, including SET, standard support, when not to overreact to one failed transfer, what embryology metrics to review, and when to consider uterine workup or PGT-A.
